name: L3Harris Power Paragon
old_description: L3Harris Power Paragon designs and manufactures engineered power distribution solutions. Specialty is custom switchgear – including low-, medium-, and high-voltage switchgear, DC power systems and automated transfer switchgear – for commercial, utility and government power systems.
about: L3Harris Power Paragon is based in Anaheim, California, and operates under the L3Harris Technologies brand, with its web presence hosted at l3harris.com. The division designs and manufactures engineered power distribution solutions, with a specialty in custom switchgear. Its product line includes custom low-voltage and medium-voltage switchgear, power distribution control centers, automatic transfer switchgear (including paralleling systems), DC switchgear and bus systems, and high-voltage switchgear. These products are engineered for integration into complex power distribution networks. The company serves four primary industry segments: commercial construction, where its switchgear is installed in building power systems; utility and power generation, where equipment supports substation and grid distribution; government and military, meeting defense and federal facility requirements; and data centers, providing reliable power distribution for critical IT infrastructure.
